description: This file defines the DatabaseConfigController class within the Installer namespace. It extends an abstract controller and manages the pre-render phase by setting up a Vue component related to database configuration in the installation process.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the database configuration step during installation. Extends AbstractInstallerVueController and sets up the appropriate Vue component in preRender.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view for rendering by creating a Vue component for the database configuration screen and updating the current installation step state.
